description: A shell script for testing Git packed refs functionality, including setup, verifying refs, packing, checking for errors, and handling Unicode characters in refs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects success with a setup or check script.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit without tags.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.
